description: 방송미디어통신위원회_역사별 WIFI AP의 정보 [telecommunications and railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 방송미디어통신위원회. 긴급구조 목적으로 구축한 데이터로써, 전국 890개 실내 지하철역사별로 설치된 WiFi AP의 평균신호세기, 최소신호세기, 최대신호세기, 역사아이디, 인프라아이디 등으로 구성된 데이터. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 방송미디어통신위원회. Its tags are WiFi, AP, 지하철역사, 신호세기, MAC주소. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-12-23 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
